question: What is SpinDine's revenue surface for revenue-check (F003)?
answer: Recon: SpinDine uses StoreKit 2 (subscriptionGroupID=21741801) — App Store Connect is the source of truth, no Firestore mirror exists in the SpinDineSwift backend (no commerce/ directory, no app-store-notifications.ts, no creatorEarningsLedger or equivalent). For Glam, the source is Firestore creatorEarningsLedger (sum of finalized + estimated rows by month) plus app-store-notifications.ts for subscription events. Resolution: deferred. F003 ships Glam-only with DeferredAdapter handling for Spin & Dine that returns source='unavailable' with the StoreKit 2 reason. Follow-up task to ingest App Store Connect monthly summaries to be opened at acceptance time. Pre-approved by user 2026-04-28.

question: Should cost-model replace token-budget-tracker outright or co-exist?
answer: Co-exist this turn. token-budget-tracker is a Feb-2026 prose stub with stale prices and no runtime; deleting it is a separate cleanup. cost-model takes the functional slot. A follow-up task (created at acceptance time, not now) will retire token-budget-tracker after one cycle of cost-model in production.

question: Where does cost-guard write alerts?
answer: INBOX.md via the F008-owned writer module — do NOT re-implement the INBOX format. Reusing F008 keeps cost alerts in the same operator surface as quota_warn / breaker_tripped, which is the right ergonomic choice. cost-guard adds two new INBOX kinds: cost_warn and cost_breach.

question: Should config/cost_budgets.json ship with real numbers or sentinels?
answer: Sentinel zeros. Operator-supplied numbers vary per quarter and shouldn't be checked in. cost-guard short-circuits with `no_budgets_configured` when all values are 0, which is a clearer no-op than alerting on `usage > 0%` against a zero baseline.

question: Are the three known-dirty files modified by this plan?
answer: No. claude/PORTABILITY.md, claude/scripts/sync-harness.sh, dashboard/state/costs.json are listed in protected_paths and stay untouched. The new dashboard/state/revenue.json is a sibling file, not a modification of costs.json.

question: Why is this its own plan and not appended to 2026-04-19-001?
answer: The parent plan F006/F007/F008/F020 is orchestration-agent observability (per-plan dispatch decisions, agent quotas). This plan is app-level financial observability (per-product cost/revenue). Different consumers, different lane. Sub-plan dependency is recorded in plan.md frontmatter `dependencies`.

question: Resolver validate.py exit code — locked AC says 'must exit 0' but baseline already fails.
answer: Resolved via minimal baseline hard-error fix. User chose option (b): one-line edit to claude/skills/subagent-driven-dev/SKILL.md frontmatter (name: subagent-driven-development → subagent-driven-dev) to match the directory name. Post-fix: validate.py reports `Result: WARN (0 errors, 49 warnings)` and exits 0. The 49 legacy warnings on other skills (missing trigger_keywords / applicable_agents / phase / required sections) remain explicitly out of scope for #692 — they are baseline conformance debt for those skills' owners. The three #692 skills (cost-model, cost-guard, revenue-check) introduced zero new issues and remain green throughout.

question: Why does cost-guard reload inbox.py via importlib instead of a normal import?
answer: scripts/jarvis_orchestrate/inbox.py lives outside any installable package; making it importable from claude/skills/ via `from scripts.jarvis_orchestrate.inbox import append_event` would require either (1) adding scripts/ to sys.path globally, or (2) packaging the orchestrator. Both are larger changes. importlib.util.spec_from_file_location keeps the dependency local to cost-guard. The only quirk: dataclasses defined in spec-loaded modules need sys.modules registration before exec_module; both cost_guard.py and revenue_check.py do this explicitly with a comment.

title: Plan close-out: status flipped after inventory audit
body: Plan inventory audit (2026-05-09) flagged this plan as status:draft despite all 3 features (F001 cost-model, F002 cost-guard, F003 revenue-check) showing passes:true since 2026-04-28. D006-D008 cover the design questions resolved during implementation; no outstanding work was identified. Status flipped from draft → completed to align the plan-list view with reality. No code change.
